mapper.select: SELECT revision.id, revision.title_zh_cn, revision.content_zh_cn, revision.title_en_us, revision.content_en_us, CONCAT('notification.template.', template.template_code, '.title') AS title_key, CONCAT('notification.template.', template.template_code, '.message') AS message_key FROM notification_template_revision revision JOIN notification_template template ON template.id = revision.template_id WHERE revision.id = #{templateRevisionId} AND template.enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_send_task (execution_key, task_status, channel, template_revision_id, recipient_criteria_json, variables_json, recipient_count, scheduled_at, time_zone, chunk_size, created_by, creation_reason) VALUES (#{executionKey}, 'SCHEDULED', 'IN_APP', #{templateRevisionId}, CAST(#{criteria} AS JSON), CAST(#{variables} AS JSON), #{recipientCount}, #{scheduledAt}, #{timeZone}, #{chunkSize}, #{createdBy}, #{reason})

INSERT INTO notification_recipient (send_task_id, student_id, delivery_status) VALUES
(#{taskId}, #{studentId}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, execution_key AS executionKey, template_revision_id, variables_json FROM notification_send_task WHERE task_status = 'SCHEDULED' AND scheduled_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY scheduled_at, id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_send_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'SCHEDULED'
UPDATE notification_send_task SET task_status = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE notification_send_task SET task_status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{reason}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{taskId}
UPDATE notification_send_task SET task_status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{operatorId}, cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'SCHEDULED'
mapper.select: SELECT task.id, task.execution_key, task.task_status, task.channel, task.recipient_count, task.scheduled_at, task.time_zone, task.failure_reason, task.created_at, task.started_at, task.completed_at, SUM(recipient.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED') AS delivered_count, SUM(recipient.delivery_status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count FROM notification_send_task task LEFT JOIN notification_recipient recipient ON recipient.send_task_id = task.id GROUP BY task.id ORDER BY task.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
